# Eraya Experience

> Eraya Experience (Eraya Experience LLP) is a creative and digital marketing agency based in Porvorim, Goa, India, working with brands across India and worldwide. It offers graphic and logo design, photoshoots, social media marketing, Meta and Google ads, influencer marketing, brand kits, and websites with SEO, all under one roof and measured by real, trackable growth.

- Founded and led by Alizah Alam (Founder) and Gopal Walawalkar (Co-Founder)
- Based in Porvorim, Goa, India; serves clients across India and worldwide, with all work delivered remotely
- 6+ years of experience, 30+ brands grown, 10+ creative minds
- Works with food and beverage, hospitality, wellness, fashion, finance, construction and non-profit brands, including Sukkha, Carlito's by the Sea, Lilliput, Koleso 24/7 Lounge Bar, Istorea by the Sea, Snow Park Goa, Thunder World Goa, Mission Rabies, Garudadhwaj Foundation, Get Secured, The Adhisha, House of Yogis, The A-Frame Builders and Nutradried
- Every campaign is tied to a tracked number: reach, engagement, enquiries, footfall or sales
- Contact: info.erayaexp@gmail.com, +91 92260 18377

## Services

- [Graphic & Logo Design](https://www.erayaexperience.com/#services): Logos, posters and campaign graphics with a point of view, recognised in a second and remembered long after.
- [Photoshoots](https://www.erayaexperience.com/#services): Food, drinks, fashion and lifestyle shoots, styled and lit so the product is the hero of every frame.
- [Social Media Marketing](https://www.erayaexperience.com/#services): Pages planned around the audience and the brand's goals. Consistent, aesthetic and always on brand.
- [Meta & Google Ads](https://www.erayaexperience.com/#services): Ads built around one number, return. Every rupee tracked, every campaign sharpened.
- [Influencer Marketing](https://www.erayaexperience.com/#services): The right creators for the brand, matched to the audience so people talk, share and show up.
- [Brand Kits](https://www.erayaexperience.com/#services): Logo, colours, type and branded essentials in one complete kit.
- [Website & SEO](https://www.erayaexperience.com/#services): Fast, beautiful websites built to rank on Google and turn visitors into customers.

## Work

- [Case studies](https://www.erayaexperience.com/#case-studies): Mission Rabies (912.5K reach, 11,666 engagements, 727 new followers), Snow Park Goa (20% lift in walk-ins, 50M+ reach), Beach Walk Resort (80,404 views, external taps up 1,900%), Sukkha (17+ hiring enquiries in one day), Get Secured (brand kit in 3 days) and a fashion label (0 to 189 sales in its first month).
- [Creative portfolio](https://www.erayaexperience.com/#portfolio): Event posters, social campaigns and brand feeds.
- [Events](https://www.erayaexperience.com/#events): Istoria with Maka Di Beer (North Goa), The Millennial Summit at the Royal Opera House with Rotary District 3141 (Mumbai) and the I-Run Marathon Goa Edition with I-Help Foundation.
- [Creators](https://www.erayaexperience.com/#creators): The creator network behind Eraya's influencer campaigns.
- [Testimonials](https://www.erayaexperience.com/#testimonials): Namitha Nair, Mission Rabies: "Awesome work. A genuinely good job from the whole team." Avydhut, Get Secured: "Great work. We truly appreciate everything you put into this."
